verdict.rationale: Unreal Editor is clearly the primary place where levels are built. The evidence shows Actors placed into Levels and post-process volumes placed in scenes. Multi-User Editing connects editor instances to build 'a single virtual world' together, and Paper 2D supports building 2D levels 'entirely within the editor' with tile-map painting. Reflection metadata exposes properties as editor functionality, and a community user praises building environments in it; another calls the UI clunky, which bears on quality rather than capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the viewport and Details/inspector panel, documentation of a prefab-equivalent workflow (e.g. Blueprint actors or level instances) for scene composition, and hands-on corroboration of the level-editing workflow itself.
